title: Independently recount #4505's installed adapters: one logically identical segment, allowance −100 per orientation (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/native-splice-recount/`. It is an independent logical recount of Dugongue's #4505, the borrowed rank-one adapters installed in the complete THREE-base native word.

**Claim type:** an independent recount by separately written code. **No new κ.**

## Results (both orientations)

- **Nothing paid moves.** Every non-scalar event is identical and in order, so the paid profile, transports and warps are unchanged.
- **Local and logically exact.** All changes lie in **one** scalar segment (index 4,984; 4,208 → 4,210 scalars). Replayed as exact rational linear maps, the old and new segments have the identical effect on all 411 touched fields, so borrowed fields are restored.
- **Tariff.** The scalar allowance, re-implemented from its stated rule, is **158,120 → 158,020** forward and **158,168 → 158,068** backward: exactly 100 saved per orientation, as #4505 reports.

## Evidence

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-splice-recount --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-splice-recount
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/native-splice-recount outcome=completed   (~1 s, stdlib only)
```

Head: `eb80ed386cd3b6442d2cca012ea24c47768b5d7e`. Base: canonical main `f9f85c1e`.

## Not covered

- Physical frames, phases and the prefix envelope (#4505's own replay).
